integrity: Proof is a self-contained exact Fourier-aliasing and rational-dilation argument. Deterministic numerical experiments are supporting checks, not proof or external validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite-degree complex polynomials, known two positive radii, noiseless pointwise modulus, balanced 2d-point regular grids; no irregular-grid or noise-stability theorem. Earlier two-circle constructions have the same sample count; this classification isolates their balanced rotational geometry.
title: Exact angular-resonance threshold for balanced concentric phase-retrieval grids
